title: Weekly Market Pulse: This Again?
description: Economic data released last week was positive, but the current environment is one of falling growth. S&P 500 was down 2.2% last week, which qualifies as a correction in a speculative market.

title: A Wobbly World
description: Our equities markets seem to be gradually ebbing. While Treasuries have rallied, this has not been the case for our other credit markets. Volatility has been increasing noticeably.

title: The Critical Role Of Fixed Income
description: Dan Ivascyn, Group CIO, discusses the evolving yield curve and how bonds can help bolster portfolios against negative economic scenarios, like market shocks or a slowdown in growth.

title: Sentiment Speaks: Big Bond Rally Is Coming Despite The Fed
description: The bond market is finally bottoming out over the coming months and should begin a major rally into 2023.

title: Fed Loses Control
description: A wave of REIT dividend hikes was a bright spot amid the carnage this week, as four equity REITs and four mortgage REITs hiked their dividends. Read more here.

title: Taxable Total Return Q2 2022 Review
description: As the Treasury curve flattened and yields rose, spreads on investment-grade corporates and taxable municipals continued to show signs of weakness.

title: The 'crashy vibes of March' could be prelude to a hard landing, warns Bank of America strategist
description: A "prelude to a hard landing and credit events." Bank of America warns that there's a whole lot of trouble under Wall Street's hood thanks to a year's worth of rate hikes.

title: Third Quarter 2023 - CIO Overview
description: One could use the word anomaly for Q3 of the stock market. S&P 500 performance for the first two months of the quarter was driven by the “magnificent seven” large-cap tech-oriented stocks.

title: Is The Bond Market Set To Roar In 2024?
description: The US bond market has had a rough ride for much of the past two years, but the powerful rally over the last two months suggests the worst is over.
